mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_purchase_plan (plan_id, tenant_id, plan_number, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{planId}, #{tenantId}, #{planNumber}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT plan_id, tenant_id, plan_number, status, created_at, updated_at FROM scm_purchase_plan WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_purchase_plan_line ( plan_id, tenant_id, line_id, seller_sku, order_demand_quantity, replenishment_demand_quantity, available_inventory_quantity, in_purchasing_quantity, suggested_purchase_quantity, order_source_refs, suggestion_source_refs, line_status, linked_po_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{planId}, #{tenantId}, #{lineId}, #{sellerSku}, #{orderDemandQuantity}, #{replenishmentDemandQuantity}, #{availableInventoryQuantity}, #{inPurchasingQuantity}, #{suggestedPurchaseQuantity}, #{orderSourceRefs}, #{suggestionSourceRefs}, #{lineStatus}, #{linkedPoId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT plan_id, tenant_id, line_id, seller_sku, order_demand_quantity, replenishment_demand_quantity, available_inventory_quantity, in_purchasing_quantity, suggested_purchase_quantity, order_source_refs, suggestion_source_refs, line_status, linked_po_id, created_at, updated_at FROM scm_purchase_plan_line WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY seller_sku, line_id
